description.value: Eva Schnitzelhaus is a modern German-Austrian sit-down restaurant on Fisgard Street in Victoria's Chinatown neighbourhood, built around creative schnitzel variations that blend Pacific Northwest local ingredients with traditional European heritage. The casual menu spans spaetzle, sausages, raclette, and a curated lineup of German draught beers alongside BC craft options, making it a satisfying stop for a cyclist needing a full hot meal.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m; stands (4 spaces) at 69m; stands (2 spaces) at 74m; stands (4 spaces) at 75m; stands (6 spaces) at 84m; stands at 85m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at evaschnitzel.com is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (509 Fisgard St) while supplying a phone number absent from OSM. The FAQ explicitly confirms vegetarian/vegan and gluten-free accommodation, and the homepage confirms delivery via Skip the Dishes, DoorDash, and Uber Eats. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site, so those fields are null; the OSM name 'Eva Schnitzelhous' is a clear misspelling flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM name field 'Eva Schnitzelhous' is a misspelling; the correct name per the business website and OSM name:en tag is 'Eva Schnitzelhaus'.
OSM has no phone number listed; website provides (250) 590-4590.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website, reservation system, and full menu. Straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal in Victoria.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms 'our menu items can easily be adjusted to be meat free and we have a few vegetarian options' plus an Eggplant Schnitzel; also 'a gluten free schnitzel (rice breading) and a gluten free fryer'
